title: Differenciate the dev app/examples
body:
We need to put ourselves in a more realistic dev situation: without bootstrap.

To see if we need some more default styling, like active refinement and spacing around inputs/checkboxes (cc @redox)

We need to present more examples to our users (bootstrap, jquery widget..).

For this, I propose to move the example dev app to dev/, keep using webpack for our needs.
Then make the bootstrap example using only pure html/css/js (and jsdelivr).

TODO:

* \[x] move the dev example to dev/
* \[x] stop publishing the dev example to gh-pages
* \[x] create examples/ dir
* \[ ] create examples/bootstrap.html and redo the same example, without any webpack involved
* \[x] the new dev app will be ugly, then we can have our own dev "theme" in dev/style.css

Examples will at first not be accessible, we should make them accessible at some point in our documentation website (algolia.github.io/instantsearch.js)
